admission.justification: Separately owned serving composition, observation scheduling and safety operations must not mistake missing page interest or launch permission for permission to hide required observations; operation-level tests guard the distinct boundary.

applicability: Landing background discovery and new probe admission in a serving runtime bound to the Projector state stream.
conditions: The app binds the real shared subscriber predicate before background startup.
Interest is rechecked after awaited discovery and at semaphore admission.
exclusions: Explicit unbound refresh callers retain their API.
Already admitted worker operations are not cancelled merely on subscriber departure.
Provider safety and local projection/healing are not stopped by landing disinterest.
statement: The serving composition binds landing work to the actual Projector subscriber set and admits no contract discovery or remote probe without a subscriber, rechecking interest after discovery and before each semaphore-admitted probe.
